annotation.title_clean: Framework of ethical aspects of artificial intelligence, robotics and related technologies (European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission, 2020/2012(INL))
annotation.title_en: Framework of ethical aspects of artificial intelligence, robotics and related technologies (European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission, 2020/2012(INL))
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 404/63
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament legislative-initiative resolution asking the Commission to propose a Regulation on ethical principles for AI, robotics and related technologies. It proposes a risk-based approach with an exhaustive high-risk sector list, national supervisory authorities, a European certificate of ethical compliance, and an annexed draft regulation. It also covers transport, autonomous vehicles and lethal autonomous weapons.
key_provisions_or_claims: Requests a Regulation on ethical principles for AI, robotics and related technologies under Article 114 TFEU
Risk-based approach with an exhaustive, cumulative list of high-risk sectors and uses, including automated driving and autonomous military systems
Each Member State designates a national supervisory authority, with coordination at Union level
Proposes a European certificate of ethical compliance, possibly mandatory for public procurement of high-risk systems
Calls for an international ban on lethal autonomous weapons without meaningful human control
